_comment: Same tiered-WAN setup as run_wan_latency_sweep.json, but the netelect groups run with petition_direct_election=true: when a petition is accepted, the proposed leader (majority-petition receiver) immediately starts its own election instead of forcing the old leader down and waiting for an election timeout. This removes the timeout race where a non-receiver node occasionally wins, so the post-petition leader should match the proposed leader far more reliably. Uses config/cluster.*.wan.pde.json. Compare against the baseline run_wan_latency_sweep (petition_direct_election=false) on migration-success-rate / which node wins / election-message count. The raft baseline group is identical to the baseline sweep (netelect disabled, petition not used).
